default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-828.title: Directional-streak exhaustion turn
E-828.hypothesis: After n consecutive bars each making a lower low (or higher high), the first bar that reverses with a higher high and higher close shows sellers (buyers) are spent; trade the turn.

E-829.title: Open-drive bar follow
E-829.hypothesis: A larger-than-usual bar that opens at one extreme and closes at the other shows one side controlled the whole bar with no pullback; follow it.

E-830.title: Floor-pivot R1/S1 rejection
E-830.hypothesis: Classic floor-trader pivots from the prior session are watched levels; a poke through R1/S1 that closes back inside is a failed push; fade it.

E-831.title: RSI(2) dip inside an EMA trend
E-831.hypothesis: A very short-term oversold reading while price is above its EMA is a brief shakeout of weak hands in an uptrend; buy it (mirror for sells).

E-832.title: Highest-volume bar follow
E-832.hypothesis: The bar with the highest volume of the window and a body over half its range shows aggressive one-sided participation; follow its direction.

E-833.title: New closing high below VWAP fade
E-833.hypothesis: A rally to a new window closing high that is still below the session VWAP runs into volume-weighted supply from trapped longs; fade it (mirror for lows above VWAP).

E-834.title: VWAP retest after a stretch
E-834.hypothesis: After price stretched far from VWAP, a pullback that touches VWAP and closes back on the trend side shows institutional buyers (sellers) defending their average price; follow.

E-835.title: Two-bar swing failure
E-835.hypothesis: A bar that makes a new window extreme and is then fully engulfed by a close beyond its opposite end traps breakout traders; trade against the failed break.

E-836.title: Multi-horizon momentum alignment
E-836.hypothesis: When short, medium and long horizon returns turn to the same sign with a long-horizon move above normal, participants of different horizons agree and the move should extend.

E-837.title: Half-hour block return fade
E-837.hypothesis: Algorithms and desks rebalance on the half hour; a larger-than-usual move in the block just ended tends to be partly reversed as the new block starts.
